title: Low lunge
steps: Start on your hands and knees on the mat.
Step one foot forward and place it flat, with the knee above the ankle.
Slide the other knee back until you feel a gentle stretch at the front of that hip.
Rest your hands on your front thigh or on the mat and breathe slowly.
Step back to hands and knees, then change sides.
mistakes: Letting the front knee fall inward.
Sinking the hips further than feels comfortable.
